nom: Neutrogena Stubborn Blackheads Daily Acne Facial Serum with Salicylic

avis.texte: This stuff smells absolutely horrible, so if you're using it for your nose you're going to have a bad day... but it works so well that it's worth it in my opinion. I haven't experienced any of the negative issues that other people mentioned. Regarding chemical burns - I don't have sensitive skin, and I've only used it a max of once per day, and no issues so far. Cleared up my skin super quick as well so I'm only using it as needed vs daily. Regarding bleaching of pillow cases, I waited a minimum of 30 minutes before going to bed and haven't noticed any issues with discoloration of my pillow cases. (My pillow cases are black) So far I'm happy with my purchase.

avis.titre: Works really well but dries you out so use lotion
avis.texte: Very easy to apply. Right after a shower I will squeeze a small amount on my forehead, both cheeks, around my nose and my chin. I rub it in, let it dry and then apply face lotion. If I forget the lotion, I will be reminded of it all day because my face will be so tight and shiny. (I don't wear make up) It's not oily, kind of watery and thin tbh. Gotta rub it in fast. Keeps my face clear and my pores normal looking. This is my second time purchasing, will repurchase after this as well.

avis.titre: Gentle Yet Effective Serum for Clearing Pores
avis.texte: This serum has been a great addition to my skincare routine. The mix of salicylic, glycolic, mandelic, and polyhydroxy acids works together to unclog pores and smooth skin texture without being overly harsh. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and doesn’t leave my skin greasy. With consistent use, I’ve noticed fewer blackheads and clearer, more balanced skin. The 1 oz bottle is small but a little goes a long way. Overall, this is a powerful yet gentle serum for anyone dealing with stubborn blackheads.

avis.titre: Es una maravilla este producto se ven los cambiosEs una maravilla este producto se ven los cambios
avis.texte: Hola a todos aqui dejo mi opinión acerca de este producto para mi es uno de los que mas me ayudado en el tema de acne este es mi segundo bote que estoy utilizando yo lo conocí por mi hermna ella me regalo el primero y me ayudo mucho no me enrito y la otra que vi cambios en el tono de mi piel aparte que me ayudo a disminuir me aclaro las manchas y aqui les dejo una foto del antes y el después. Para ver resultados hay que ser muy constante yo la uso de dia y de noche.
I definitely felt the difference the first day. Large blackheads I couldn’t get rid of before were barely there a few hours later. I accidentally bought 2 but I’m keeping the other for sure.
Highly recommend for minimizing pores and decreasing black heads. Cheaper on Amazon than in stores and works well. The only drawback is that it doesn’t smell great.

avis.titre: Smells terrible and doesn’t do much
avis.texte: It works but not to warrant the price and little amount you get. It’s not really anything great in fact I’ve seen much better products with a better smell. It smells like a fish kept in a plastic bag for six months I don’t know why they couldn’t cover it up better. Didn’t irritate my skin thankfully.

avis.titre: Seems to be making a difference after 1 month
avis.texte: I've used many products that claim to treat blackheads. I have oily skin and large pores, and even though I scrub and treat, nothing seemed to make any improvement. I've been using this product for about a month on my nose and chin, and I'm starting to see results. My pores don't necessarily look smaller, but they are definitely not as dark. So I'm encouraged after trying so many things that didn't work, even other products from Neutrogena. I will keep using and I'll update this review after another month or so.

avis.titre: Me gusto mucho ojalá lo vuelvan a tener a la venta en México
avis.texte: Esta buenísimo, seca los brotes muy rapido y si me disminuyo el acne este suero, no tengo muchos brotes pero me salen hormonales en la barbilla, noté que los seca muy rapido como si fueran pasitas y asi no se me lastima tanto la cara con ese acne hormonal que duele mucho y es grande en la zona de la barbilla. Aparte deja la piel más suave y se me quitaron las marcas después del acne más rapido con ese producto.

Llevo años usando este producto y hasta ahora ha sido el único que me funciona para que la piel no esté tan grasosa pero sin secarla. El olor puede ser un poco extraño al inicio pero después de un minuto realmente ya no se nota.
Es muy buen producto, me está ayudando mucho a quitar las marquitas de acné. Sí lo recomiendo
Mis hijos sufren de brotes de acne en la frente y mejillas y las seca super rapidisimo, lo recomiendo
I like the applicator tip. I’m not a fan of the smell. Kind of medicinal. It doesn’t burn like other products I’ve used. I use this after cleansing and dark spot application.
It works great to get rid of my blackheads! All my blackheads are gone in a week! It’s smells terrible though…

avis.titre: Broke My Face Out With First Use. Adding An Extra Star Because It Does Help With Blackheads
avis.texte: The purpose of my trying this was to see if I could get rid of stubborn blackheads on my nose and t-zone. It did great for the blackheads. No issue there. That part worked. Its the itchy red face that I cant deal with. The serum started making my face puffy, itchy, red and blotchy after the first use. It started swelling up right away. I couldn't stop scratching my face, which of course didn't make it any better. Even after washing my face with gentle cleanser, it still was very red. I have large pores but not bumps or acne. Bumps starting popping up, as my face grew itchier. This serum just isn't for me. My skin didn't like it at all. This is a dermatologist-grade acid complex also formulated with 5% glycolic acid. It could be too strong for my face.

It’s a very light thin solution that can easily be added to your daily route. I use it on my nose and down my face outlining the sides of my smile. I’m pleased; my pores are clearing & decreasing I. size without squeezing which leaves noticeable red irritation. Thank you Neutrogena!

avis.titre: Interesting spout, will update with longer term frequent use.
avis.texte: * I am in my early 30s with sensitive acne-prone skin with very very dry patches. I have some acne scars, discoloration and quite a bit of sebaceous filaments. Description of Product: - Name: Neutrogena Stubborn Blackheads Daily Acne Facial Serum with Salicylic, Glycolic, Polyhydroxy & Mandelic Acids, Oil-Free Face Serum for Acne-Prone Skin to Help Clear Clogged Pores, 1 fl. oz - Color, Texture and Scent: This is a slightly milky white, serum that is slightly runny. It is fragrance-free, though it does have a slight scent of the ingredients that goes away pretty quickly. - Other Characteristics: It has a super interesting looking spout that reminds me of a dropper. My Impression: - When Applied: It applies easily and gets absorbed / dries pretty quickly without leaving a residue - Afterwards: I have not experienced any redness, irritation, burning or breakouts after using this product. Conclusion: - Overall? It suggests usage up to 3 times a day, which I haven't done so yet - maybe this is why I haven't really seen any improvements in blackheads / pore size or sebaceous filaments but I'll continue using this to see if it helps. It also warns of drying or peeling of skin, which I haven't experienced so far. I'll update the review with further longer-term use.

I'm going to give this more time. The "stubborn blackhead" title drew me in since I already tried using a lot of different acids with minimal effect... my tzone is very difficult. No miracles yet. Right now I'm using it once a day, there's been no irritation or dryness yet. Hopefully I can give a positive update once I've used it up.

avis.titre: Great stuff works quickly, but don’t overuse
avis.texte: This is a salicylic acid gel in a small tube. You apply it to pimples and they go away in a day or so. Do not over use it as your skin will dry out and may peel. I wouldn’t use more than once a day. Also has a warning about sun burn with use. Otherwise it works well in moderation.
